Casting <arc/>Thunderclap refunds ~45% Melee Ability Energy after use. Kills with Thunderclap and this exotic's Lightning Strikes refund ?% additional melee energy per kill, up to a maximum of 50%.

Upon activating and upon discharging <arc/>Thunderclap, summon <arc/>Jolting Lightning strikes in a 15 meter radius around you, dealing <pve 181 /> <pvp [50] /> damage. Lightning Strikes instantly trigger their <arc/>Jolt chains during both events, and damage is doubled while <arc/>Amplified.

Lightning Damage can be further increased by up to 200% by fully charging <arc/>Thunderclap, which stacks multiplicatively with the damage bonus from being <arc/>Amplified.

Casting <arc/>Thunderclap refunds Melee Ability Energy after use. Refund amount is FPS-based, granting 10|18|32|41|77% Melee Ability Energy at 30|60|120|144|300 frames.

Kills with Thunderclap and this exotic's Lightning Strikes refund additional melee energy per kill, up to a maximum of 50%.

Upon activating and upon discharging <arc/>Thunderclap, summon <arc/>Jolting Lightning strikes in a 15 meter radius around you, dealing <pve 181 /> <pvp [50] /> damage. Lightning Strikes instantly trigger their <arc/>Jolt chains during both events, and their damage is doubled while <arc/>Amplified.

Lightning Damage can be further increased by up to 200% by fully charging <arc/>Thunderclap, which stacks multiplicatively with the damage bonus from being <arc/>Amplified.
